documentation_gaps.title: Create CONTRIBUTING.md with contribution guidelines
documentation_gaps.description: The monorepo lacks a CONTRIBUTING.md file at the root level. Currently, new developers have no formal onboarding guide for contributing code, running tests, or understanding the PR workflow. There's no guidance on commit message conventions, branch naming, or code review processes.
documentation_gaps.rationale: A CONTRIBUTING.md is essential for open-source best practices and team onboarding. It establishes clear expectations for code contributions, reduces friction for new developers, and ensures consistent code quality across the team. Most professional projects have this as a standard file.
documentation_gaps.currentDocumentation: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists at root level
documentation_gaps.proposedContent: Create comprehensive CONTRIBUTING.md covering: 1) Development setup, 2) Code style/linting rules, 3) Branch naming conventions, 4) Commit message format (Co-Authored-By pattern), 5) PR process and review checklist, 6) Testing requirements, 7) Design system compliance requirements, 8) SDK-first rule adherence, 9) i18n localization requirements

documentation_gaps.title: Add README.md documentation to @xala/i18n package
documentation_gaps.description: The packages/i18n directory is missing a README.md file. The i18n package provides critical localization functionality (useT hook, nb/en translations) but has no package-level documentation explaining its API, usage patterns, or how to add new translations. Developers must read source code to understand usage.
documentation_gaps.rationale: The i18n package is used across all three frontend apps (web, backoffice, minside) and is referenced extensively in CLAUDE.md rules. Without README documentation, developers struggle to understand: how to add new translation keys, the key naming conventions (common.*, auth.*, nav.*), how to use the useT() hook, and how the locale switching works.
documentation_gaps.currentDocumentation: Only docs/packages/06-i18n.md exists but no package-level README; docs/I18N_SCAN_REPORT references i18n but doesn't document API
documentation_gaps.proposedContent: Create README with: 1) Quick start examples, 2) useT() hook usage with TypeScript, 3) Translation key naming conventions (common.*, auth.*, nav.*, bookings.*, etc.), 4) How to add new translations to both nb.ts and en.ts, 5) Locale switching API, 6) Integration examples for React components, 7) i18n scanner usage

documentation_gaps.title: Create comprehensive environment variables reference
documentation_gaps.description: Environment variables are scattered across multiple .env.example files in apps/web, apps/backoffice, apps/minside, and apps/api without centralized documentation. Each app has 6-15 required environment variables but there's no single reference explaining what each variable does, valid values, and security considerations.
documentation_gaps.rationale: New developers and DevOps personnel waste time figuring out which environment variables are required. Sensitive variables like VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN, JWT_SECRET, IDPORTEN_CLIENT_SECRET need clear documentation on how to obtain and secure them. This is critical for deployment and local development setup. The project_index.json shows 40+ environment variables across apps.
documentation_gaps.currentDocumentation: Only .env.example files exist with minimal comments; docs/guides/03-deployment.md touches on environment but not comprehensive
documentation_gaps.proposedContent: Create reference doc covering: 1) All VITE_* frontend variables by app, 2) API server variables (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SESSION_SECRET, etc.), 3) Third-party service tokens (Mapbox, Sentry, ID-porten), 4) Multi-tenant configuration (VITE_TENANT_ID), 5) Security best practices for secrets, 6) Local development defaults vs production, 7) WebSocket URL configuration (VITE_WS_URL)

documentation_gaps.title: Document API error codes and handling patterns
documentation_gaps.description: While the codebase mentions RFC 7807 Problem Details for errors, there's no comprehensive reference of all error codes, their meanings, and recommended handling patterns. The SDK throws ApiError with codes like VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR but no exhaustive list exists with all business-specific error types.
documentation_gaps.rationale: Frontend developers need to know all possible error codes to implement proper error handling UI. The SDK README shows basic error handling but doesn't list all error types specific to booking conflicts, rate limiting, GDPR violations, or tenant isolation errors. This leads to inconsistent error handling across apps.
documentation_gaps.currentDocumentation: SDK README mentions 6 error codes; apps/api/CLAUDE.md mentions RFC 7807 but actual API may return more business-specific errors
documentation_gaps.proposedContent: Create error code reference: 1) Complete list of error codes with HTTP status codes, 2) Business rule violation errors (BOOKING_CONFLICT, SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, etc.), 3) Recommended UI handling patterns with i18n keys, 4) Rate limiting errors and retry strategies, 5) Validation error format with field-level errors, 6) Authentication/authorization error flow, 7) Tenant isolation errors

documentation_gaps.title: Add inline comments to complex booking pricing algorithm
documentation_gaps.description: The booking pricing calculation in the SDK (use-booking-quote.ts hook) handles complex scenarios including time-based pricing, participant pricing, seasonal rates, and discount codes, but lacks inline comments explaining the algorithm. The pricing logic spans multiple files without clear documentation of precedence rules.
documentation_gaps.rationale: Pricing is business-critical functionality that municipalities rely on for accurate billing. The pricing algorithm handles edge cases like overlapping pricing tiers, participant-based calculations, and discount stacking that are not obvious from code alone. Bugs in pricing could have financial implications for kommune budgets.
documentation_gaps.currentDocumentation: Hook functions have basic JSDoc comments but no algorithm explanation; no documentation of pricing tier priority rules
documentation_gaps.proposedContent: Add inline comments covering: 1) Pricing tier priority/precedence rules, 2) Time-based calculation formula, 3) Participant pricing logic (per-person vs flat rate), 4) Discount code application order and stacking rules, 5) Minimum/maximum booking constraints, 6) Seasonal rate override rules, 7) Tax calculation (MVA) handling for Norwegian municipalities
